style: Avant-garde chamber-folk art-rock with quartal suspension fields, microtonal overtone friction, and granular synthesis processing. Melodic contour uses rapid phonetic consonant patter with obsessive pharyngeal emphatics, alveolar trills, and front-rounded vowel shifts under French phrase-level prominence peaks. Rhythmic engine combines 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling, asymmetric meter collisions, and double-time hallucinations. Timbre features wavetable and subtractive synths, tagelharpa, darbuka, qanun, udu, djembe, and balafon with cassette tape saturation, spring recoil, and resonant physical modeling. Vocal topology uses a choral counterpoint lattice with a hocketed vocal cast. Performance attitude is breathless hype delivery paired with deep bewilderment headspace. Arrangement uses dry separation stemminess with acoustic source exposure, transient snap, and immersive spatial positioning to heighten the sensation of physical evaporation.
lyrics:
[Intro — Darbuka and Udu Counterpoint with Wavetable Sweeps]
[Breathless Hype Delivery]
Look at the floor right now! Did you see it drop?
Another second ticks and the keys just stop!
We are counting backwards from an absent sum!
Why do I lose everything all the time?
Is the universe consuming every object that I climb?
Do the molecules disband the moment that I look away?
Tracing trajectories of decay!

[Verse 1 — Qanun Arpeggios and Bowed Tagelharpa Drone]
[Headspace: Deep Bewilderment]
Every room I enter leaves its corners bare.
I set the vessel down and swear the table was there.
An inventory of pockets turned inside out,
A ledger filled with vanishing without a doubt.
The clock ticks forward while the drawer slides back,
And every single memory has lost its track.
We checked the attic and we checked the floor,
There is nothing behind the closing door.
Even the shadows slip away from light,
Fading completely out of sight!
My own reflection wavers in the hallway glass,
Watching the solid framework slowly pass.
The coat hooks hold nothing but the empty air,
Mocking the desperation of my stare.

[Chorus — Choral Counterpoint Lattice and Balafon Pulse]
[3:2 Cross-Rhythm Coupling Active]
Why do I lose everything all the time?
Where did the morning go? Where is the chime?
We held the object tight against the open palm,
And watched it dissolve in a sudden calm!
Look at the edges fray! Look at the numbers slide!
There is nowhere left for the missing things to hide!
The fabric of the baseline tears apart,
Stealing the rhythm straight from the heart!
Every possession slips right through the fingers fast,
Nothing of yesterday is built to last!

[Verse 2 — Subtractive Synth Filter Cutoff Swells and Djembe Slaps]
[Double-Time Hallucination Activated]
If I write it down, the ink evaporates before the ink is dry.
If I memorize the shape, I watch the contour slowly die.
Keys slip through the bench, coins evaporate from fleece,
Every single anchor takes another piece.
Is it the room that moves or is it my own hand?
Writing footprints down upon shifting sinking sand.
The system logs an error in the asset tree,
And nothing left remaining belongs to me.
The very concept of possession starts to rust,
Crumbling slowly down to computational dust.
Even the name I call myself begins to blur,
Caught in the vortex of a permanent defer.

[Bridge — Jurisdiction Dropout: Harmony Removed, Rhythm and Voice Only]
[Tagelharpa Bowing Exposes Raw Wooden Friction]
Where is the coat I wore? Where is the stone?
Left in the silence of the dial-tone!
Check the ledger! Check the shelf!
Nothing remains of anybody's self!
We trace the vector back to zero point,
Dislocating every historical joint!
The gravitational pull of nothingness expands,
Slipping right out of our grasping hands!
The threshold buckles under weight of absent lead,
Leaving a vacuum where the structure used to spread!

[Climax — Perpetual Uplift: Choir Possession and Luminous Friction Orchestra]
[Meter Collision: 3+3 against 2+2+2]
Why do I lose everything all the time!
Climbing the ladder without any rung!
Singing the song that was never yet sung!
Every second breaks into a brighter spark!
Running headfirst into the open dark!
Look at it shatter! Look at it rise!
Another missing piece before our eyes!
The architecture of the moment caves in two,
Destroying every old truth and every new!
The universe devours the ground beneath our feet,
Making the cycle of erasure complete!

[Outro — Taped Spring Resonance and Abrupt Cutoff]
[Cheap Analog Hiss Exposure]
Gone from the pocket.
Gone from the mind.
Leaving nothing of the sort behind.
Why do I lose everything all the time?
The inventory ends in blank space.
[Final Spring Boing Recoil and Tape Stop]
